lines.t: In the land of sorrow, where the fields ran dry
Ruth stood beside Naomi, with a tear in her eye
The road looked empty, the journey unknown
on, but love spoke louder than fear ever shone. Wherever you go, I will go too. Your people,
my people, your God, my truth. Through harvest and heartache, through night and through sun,
The story of grace has only begun
The story of grace has only begun
From ashes to hope, from lost to divine
Redemption was written in heaven's design
From roots came a lineage, a king and a lamb
Proof that love's power is God's perfect plan
The same grace that found Ruth
The truth is calling me too
